# Universal Informatics

Bioinformatics platform for mental health. Investigating potential relationships between the Fibonacci sequence and OXTR gene expression.

Does modular compression reveal statistically significant patterns, or merely mathematical elegance?

Do the nested sequences within Fibonacci Pisano periods have biological and molecular implications?

## Initial focus · Computer vision for genomics

Inspired by research into how geometric architectures and Fibonacci-ordered dynamics can protect quantum information, we are investigating whether geometry derived from Fibonacci Pisano periods can improve the computational efficiency of hyperspectral image analysis for genomics.

## A measurable first step

Our proposed approach explores equilateral triangular meshes and tetrahedral models, comparing computational cost, processing speed and accuracy against established methods.

The initial biological application is to investigate spectral patterns potentially associated with OXTR gene expression, evaluated against independent molecular measurements.

## Future expansion · an OXTR-centred network

If independent studies verify biological significance in the OXTR–Fibonacci relationship, we plan to extend the investigation to a wider set of candidate genes and molecular systems.

## Atlas pages

To understand the geometry presented across this bioinformatics website, retrieve and read the linked JSON for the relevant Atlas or model. Read it alongside the page’s explanation to understand how the mathematical data relates to the visual geometry and the research question.

- [Geometry Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/atlas/index.html): Mathematical calculations and representations. What sequences, geometric constructions and verification results arise across Fibonacci moduli M1–M1001?
- [Transcription Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/transcription/index.html): OXTR transcription-factor binding sites, source evidence and coordinate comparisons. Explore whether the four M9 P24 geometries help predict OXTR binding-site locations.
- [Molecular Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/molecular/index.html): Molecular structure and interaction. How can OXT–OXTR molecular binding and structure be explored?
- [Quantum Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/quantum/index.html): Natural-language biological research with Astra, Gemini, coordinated calculations and public MCP/API/A2A participation. What biological questions can the coordinated AI and quantum workflow investigate, and how can people and external AIs take part?
- [Music Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/music/index.html): Sound and auditory experience. How do Fibonacci and modular sequences relate to musical structure, tuning and responses to electronic music?
- [Vision Atlas · EMDR and ocular biology](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/vision/index.html): Human eye movement and visual stimulation; an EMDR hypothesis. Does hexagonal saccadic tracking differ from bilateral horizontal tracking in EMDR visual stimulation?
- [Language Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/language/index.html): Language and mantra research. How do language, mantra and related research connect to the mental-health investigation?
- [Computer vision for genomics](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/computer-vision/index.html): Computational image analysis; a proposed algorithm research direction. Can Fibonacci Pisano geometry improve the cost, speed and accuracy of hyperspectral image analysis for genomics?

[Informatics sitemap](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/sitemap/)

## Research library

An extensive, clinically searchable research index spanning sound and auditory entrainment, EMDR, mindfulness-based stress reduction, mantra and hyperspectral imaging. Explore more than 1,300 publications by intervention, clinical condition, gene expression, molecular target, study design and journal, with transparent topic-level trust ratings.

## Read without a connector

- [Research and evidence](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/): Plain HTML overview.
- [Publications](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/publications/index.html): 1323 approved records, citations, summaries, limitations and topic assessment context.
- [Hyperspectral Imaging](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/hyperspectral/index.html): Six subchapters, 240 original citation entries and 13 timeline milestones.
- [Geometry Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/atlas/index.html): 1,001 records with complete JSON and CSV links.
- [Quantum Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/quantum/index.html): Purpose, human feature guide, agent roles, persistent workflow, MCP/API/A2A participation, saved results and JSON/CSV/Markdown downloads. The [ordinary Quantum Atlas page](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/quantum/) includes the same guide data in its initial HTML.
- [Music Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/music/index.html): Electronic-music research questions, OXTR measurement architecture, six models, equations and semantic tables and JSON/CSV/Markdown downloads. The [ordinary Music Atlas page](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/sound/) embeds the same explanations and JSON.
- [Vision Atlas · EMDR](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/vision/index.html): Human visual stimulation and the hexagonal tracking hypothesis.
- [Computer vision for genomics](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/computer-vision/index.html): Hyperspectral image-analysis algorithm research.
- [Experiments](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/experiments/index.html): Versioned measurements, methods and limitations.
- [Data and methods](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/data.html): Full source inventory and checksums.
- [Archive record](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/provenance.html): Verified storage and timestamp status.
- [AI access and reuse](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/access.html): All LLM providers may read and train on Universal Mind-owned public Informatics material. Third-party rights remain attached to original material.
- [Connect and download](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/connect.html): Optional API, MCP, A2A and complete JSON/CSV exports.

Staging is excluded. No public GitHub repository is asserted until a public source release exists.
